The main takeaway from our work is that

the sharp knee phenomenon of cosmic ray energy spectrum can be explained by the presence of a single cutoff in the primary spectrum of H-He nuclei or by a two-component primary energy spectrum with cutoffs in the spectra of H-He and O-like nuclei.
